_metadata.description: Append-only audit of every job dispatch and provisioning op (who/node/verb/args/outcome) via workspace-sandbox.

requirements.title: Immutable Audit Trail
requirements.description: Every job dispatch and every provisioning operation — who, which node, what verb/args, outcome — is recorded to an append-only audit trail (workspace-sandbox as the accountability substrate), because remote code execution and remote provisioning must be fully traceable after the fact.

validation.notes: Each dispatch/provision writes an immutable audit record with actor, node, verb/args, and outcome; records cannot be mutated.
Audit records are routed to the workspace-sandbox accountability substrate rather than a bespoke store.
After a gate run, every executed verb and provisioning step is reconstructable from the audit trail.
